postgres_requirements.rationale: CORRECTED IN R2 (certification blocker B3). A real PostgreSQL proof is MANDATORY: every substantive claim of this node is a runtime privilege behaviour no static check can establish. Both harness paths remain legitimately UNKNOWN because the repository carries TWO admissible real-PG shapes -- suites pairing a *.pg.test.ts with a *-harness.ts and *.probes.json (b3, b4, b5, fibdb052-p1-indexes, portfolio-aggregate, s3refusal) and suites carrying neither (ce1-commercial-account, organization-commercial-acceptance) -- and the CLOSEST SIBLING, which this node extends, is of the second shape. TWO SUBSTRATES, ONE CONTRACT (authority SECTION_10 and SECTION_17). (1) CANONICAL: the L1 behavioural suite runs on its ACTUAL harness image, DEFAULT_IMAGE = postgres:16-alpine, measured at scripts/db-audit-disposable.ts:502 and consumed at tests/postgres/organization-commercial-acceptance.pg.test.ts:714. The R1 manifest froze public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.143 instead; that was NOT EXECUTABLE, because on that image the role postgres is not a superuser and the fixture's own HOSTED_FIDELITY re-home loop dies with 'must be able to SET ROLE "uellix_owner"' (measured, both images). No impossible setup is frozen as a required gate. (2) OWNER_TOPOLOGY_PROBE: a certification-only substrate with a NON-SUPERUSER function owner, required because the canonical fixture's function owner is postgres and postgres is a SUPERUSER there (rolsuper=t measured), which makes any owner-capability assertion vacuous. (3) SUPPLEMENTAL_FIDELITY: a Supabase-image probe is permitted ONLY when explicitly classified as such and never as the source of a PG-06 pass. IN ALL CASES: DISPOSABLE ONLY, no bind mounts, teardown in finally, leftover check, gated and skipped-never-silently-passed; NEVER hosted staging, NEVER production, NEVER the canonical local Supabase stack; and a substrate that satisfies a control by widening a runtime role is INVALID EVIDENCE. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/organization-commercial-acceptance.pg.test.ts, with fixtures in tests/postgres/organization-commercial-acceptance-fixtures.ts.

mutation_controls.description: STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. Remove SECURITY DEFINER from the trigger function (keeping everything else). EXPECTED RED: P-01 fails with 42501 permission denied for SCHEMA AUTH raised inside the PL/pgSQL body, and FN-01 fails. UNIQUE ANCHOR: P-01 with an auth-schema error. FALSIFIABILITY IS PREMEASURED, not hypothetical -- this is exactly the pre-remediation state the authority writer observed (authority P1C).

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. SUBSTRATE=OWNER_TOPOLOGY_PROBE (a non-superuser owner is required for the states to be distinguishable). Remove SET search_path = public, keeping SECURITY DEFINER. EXPECTED RED: FN-02, plus the semantic arm below. THE SEMANTIC ARM IS A THREE-STATE PROOF AND ALL THREE ARE BINDING -- RE-MEASURED IN R2 (authority SECTION_19 R2_SEARCH_PATH): STATE_1 pin removed, owner CANNOT see the attacker schema => ATTACK REFUSED 23514 digest mismatch; STATE_2 pin removed, owner CAN see it => ATTACK SUCCEEDS and SENTINEL_FORGED_CONTENT_DIGEST is STORED, defeating I-T4-4; STATE_3 pin restored, owner still sees it => ATTACK REFUSED. Only STATE_2 falsifies the pin. A suite running STATE_1 alone observes a harmless failure and concludes the pin is unnecessary -- the exact wrong conclusion. The arm must therefore GRANT the owner USAGE on the shadow schema to reach STATE_2, which is permitted for this probe (authority SECTION_18) and implies nothing for production. UNIQUE ANCHOR: FN-02 plus SENTINEL_FORGED_CONTENT_DIGEST landing in the table in STATE_2 and in no other state.

UNIQUE ANCHOR: N-01 and N-05 together; the two-arm split exists precisely so a mutation that touches only one arm cannot hide behind the other.

Restore and re-prove GREEN before the next mutation.

THE PUBLIC ARM IS MANDATORY AND IS THE WHOLE POINT: PREMEASURED that revoking only the per-role grant leaves the positive GREEN, because auth.uid() carries EXECUTE to PUBLIC by default and the hosted baseline adds no REVOKE -- so the per-role-only form of this mutation is VACUOUS and would certify a capability nobody proved. Restoring the per-role grant with PUBLIC still revoked returns GREEN, which proves the capability rather than the grant path. UNIQUE ANCHOR: FN-04 C2.
